dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius, forming an acute morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour measuring approximately 65-70 degrees relative to the dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum vertical height to the visible basal width.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular reflectance patterns across the mid-dorsal region and fin.
